<page>
Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1058
Claimant:
Kelly Barton
Adjuster:
Jerry Hanson
June 2, 2025
Claim opened today for a sideswipe that happened while the insured's vehicle was changing lanes. The claimant
reports a shoulder injury and is not represented by an attorney.
June 25, 2025
Spoke with the claimant by phone to take the initial statement. The account of the lane change matched the
description given at first notice.
July 9, 2025
Reviewed the police report, which places the claimant inside the vehicle at the time of the collision and notes the
scene conditions without any dispute about how the vehicles came together.
July 26, 2025
Photos from the scene and the other driver's statement both line up with the claimant's version of the sideswipe. The
contact points on both cars correspond to a side-to-side impact.
August 20, 2025
Two witnesses gave statements that the claimant's vehicle drifted into the adjacent lane as the other car was passing.
Their descriptions agree with each other and with the photos.
September 21, 2025
Repair estimate came in and the damage pattern on the claimant's vehicle fits the impact described. No prior body
damage or unrepaired hits are noted in the inspection.
October 26, 2025
Confirmed the driver listed on the policy was the person operating the vehicle at the time of loss. Coverage was in
force well before the collision, and nothing in the file suggests the damage predates the policy.
November 8, 2025
Medical records received from the claimant's treating provider describe a shoulder injury that is consistent in kind and
force with a side impact of this type.
November 13, 2025
Treatment has continued somewhat longer than is typical for this kind of shoulder injury, and the provider notes
ongoing therapy sessions. Reviewing the records further for the reason.
November 14, 2025
The records show the claimant was treated for the same shoulder area about two years ago. The earlier condition
appears to add to the current complaints, and the adjuster is weighing how much of the present treatment relates to
this loss.
November 30, 2025
Spoke with the claimant again to clarify the timeline. The account of the collision and the injury was the same as in
every prior conversation, with no changes in the details.
December 17, 2025
Summary: liability appears clear based on the police report, witness statements, photos, and the other driver's
account. Injury evaluation is ongoing, with the prior shoulder treatment and the length of care under review before any
</page>

Rate each feature below that THIS page gives evidence about. Leave out a feature the page
says nothing about. The ratings are listed from least to most suspicious.
- injury_crash_fit: Does the claimed injury fit the type and force of the crash? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- treatment_growth: Did the treatment grow beyond what this injury needs? Allowed: Normal, Elevated, Disproportionate, Extreme.
- pre_existing_condition: Did an earlier condition of the same body area add to the complaints? Allowed: None, Minor, Material, Predominant.
- occurrence_support: Do independent sources (witnesses, photos, cameras, the other driver) confirm that the accident happened as described? Allowed: Confirmed, Partially corroborated, Uncorroborated, Contradicted, Suspected staged.
- damage_crash_fit: Does the vehicle damage fit the described impact? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- account_stability: Did the claimant's account of the accident stay the same over time? Allowed: Stable, Clarified, Materially changed.
- occupant_presence: Was the claimant really in the vehicle at the time of the crash? Allowed: Verified, Unclear, Added later, Not present.
- prior_damage_evidence: Is there evidence of vehicle damage from before this crash? Allowed: None, Possible, Documented, Material.
- known_loss_evidence: Is there evidence the damage existed or was known before the coverage started? Allowed: Weak, Moderate, Strong.
- driver_status: Is the driver of the insured vehicle on the policy? Allowed: Listed, Household, Unlisted, Excluded.

For each rated feature give:
- "rating": exactly one of the allowed ratings,
- "confidence": "High", "Medium" or "Low" (how clearly the page shows it),
- "quote": one or two sentences copied EXACTLY from the page that support the rating, with any
  spelling errors as they are,
- "reason": one short sentence.
